violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Staff rinsed non-gloved hand at 3 comp sink (I was using hand sink), redirected to wash at hand sink. Proceeded to wash gloved hand during hand wash. *Redirected immediately.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Tubes of raw ground beef are stored on sheet pan with packages of hot dogs and bags of shredded cheese in bottom of prep table.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. -Pre-cooked sausage patties, raw sausage, sliced cheese, and shredded cheese, all left out at room temperature during service from 8am to 11am and then remaining product returned to refrigeration. *Redirected immediately to keep in make table between uses.
